text: Exactly as described. Exactly as expected . Comes with additional attachment magnet if dishwasher is not metal/magnetic.

product_metadata.title: NoCry Dishwasher Magnet for Better Kitchen Organization; Double Sided Clean Dirty Magnet That’s Water Resistant, Reversible and Chic; Comes in Different Designs; Aqua Black
features: AWESOME DOUBLE SIDED KITCHEN MAGNET. Our dirty/clean dishwasher magnet lets you—and the whole family— know the state of your dishes instantly. The magnet is strong, thick, flexible, and water resistant with a high-gloss finish that looks great in your kitchen.

DURABLE, USEFUL MAGNET MADE TO LAST. This clean or dirty dishwasher sign is easy to flip over. The corners are soft and rounded —so they’re easy to grip. Both sides are made with durable PVC, and don’t leave residue, crease or get scratched. And it’s designed to look just as good as the day you bought it.
COMES WITH BONUS ADHESIVE METAL PLATE. You can stick the magnet to stainless steel —or any non magnetic dishwasher— using the complimentary adhesive plate.

NEAT DISHWASHER SIGN WITH A GREAT DESIGN. This strong magnet is the perfect tool for better kitchen organization. At 3.5 by 2 in, it’s easy to read and see from a distance. A wedding registry must have, it’s the perfect small gift for new homeowners, bridal showers, housewarmings and anyone looking for cute kitchen decor.

EASY TO USE AND STAYS IN PLACE. Adding this useful magnetic sign to your dishwasher is easy: just stick it on to a magnetic surface or use the complimentary adhesive. You can also use it on the fridge, the toaster, or the microwave.
